_doc: One entry per regional level (GAME_DESIGN.md: Data files / levels.json). Pack 1 only. Phase 3 uses the tileset and decorations; the other fields are filled in by later phases. All colours and shapes are placeholder art.

The Underworld, Pack 2 level 1 (docs/PACK_2_PLAN.md; GAME_DESIGN.md Act II). Asphodel meadows, the black rivers of the dead, chasms down to Tartarus. Sources: Homer, Odyssey 10-11; Hesiod, Theogony 720-819.
Jotunheim, Pack 2 level 2 (docs/PACK_2_PLAN.md; GAME_DESIGN.md Act II). High mountain passes, giant-sized ruins and glaciers. Sources: Snorri, Prose Edda (Gylfaginning; Skaldskaparmal); Thrymskvida.

Avalon's Shadow, Pack 2 level 3 (docs/PACK_2_PLAN.md; GAME_DESIGN.md Act II). Ruined castles, enchanted forest and a misty lake. Sources: the Mabinogi; Sir Gawain and the Green Knight; Malory, Le Morte d'Arthur.

The Land Between the Rivers, Pack 2 level 4 (docs/PACK_2_PLAN.md; GAME_DESIGN.md Act II). Mud-brick ziggurats, the Cedar Forest, flood plains with reeds and date palms. Sources: the Epic of Gilgamesh (Standard Babylonian version); Enuma Elish.
Pohjola, Pack 3 level 1 (docs/PACK_3_PLAN.md; GAME_DESIGN.md Act III). Dark northern pine, frozen lakes, the northern lights. Source: the Kalevala (Lonnrot, 1849).

Mazandaran, Pack 3 level 2 (docs/PACK_3_PLAN.md; GAME_DESIGN.md Act III). Mountain forests, caves, the palaces of the divs. Source: Ferdowsi, the Shahnameh (the Seven Labours of Rostam). No Persian gods are used (a living religion): shrines draw gods from the other pantheons, and the Simurgh is called with feathers.

The Slavic Wilds, Pack 3 level 3 (docs/PACK_3_PLAN.md; GAME_DESIGN.md Act III). Birch forests, rivers, wooden villages, swamps. Sources: Afanasyev's Russian Fairy Tales; the byliny; the Russian Primary Chronicle.

The Land of Legends, Pack 3 level 4 (docs/PACK_3_PLAN.md; GAME_DESIGN.md Act III). The outer paths of mountain shrines, bamboo, castle ruins. Japanese historical legend: the Gikeiki, the Tale of the Heike, the Tsuchigumo Soshi, the Oeyama tale. No kami are used (Shinto is a living religion, Tier B): shrines draw gods from every pantheon.

Muspelheim, Pack 4 realm 1, the fire realm (docs/PACK_4_PLAN.md; GAME_DESIGN.md Fantasy realms). Sources: Snorri, Gylfaginning 4-5, 51; the Poetic Edda, Fjolsvinnsmal; Paracelsus (salamanders). A realm: no local gods, shrines draw from every pantheon.
Niflheim, Pack 4 realm 2, the ice realm (docs/PACK_4_PLAN.md). Sources: Snorri, Gylfaginning 4-5, 16; the Poetic Edda: Grimnismal 32-35, Voluspa 39 and 44, Vafthrudnismal 37. A realm: no local gods.

Ys, Pack 4 realm 3, the drowned city (docs/PACK_4_PLAN.md). Sources: Albert Le Grand (1636); La Villemarque, Barzaz Breiz (1839); Souvestre, Le Foyer breton (1844); Sebillot (the mari-morgans); Le Braz, La Legende de la mort (1893); Paracelsus (undines). St Guenole is not used (owner decision). A realm: no local gods.

Cloud-Cuckoo-Land, Pack 4 realm 4, the sky realm (docs/PACK_4_PLAN.md). Sources: Aristophanes, The Birds (414 BC); the Thousand and One Nights (the Roc); Paracelsus (sylphs). Only the old texts. A realm: no local gods.

The Realm of the Ten Suns, bonus level 53 (docs/BONUS_LEVELS_PLAN.md; GAME_DESIGN.md Act IV). Scorched terraced hills, rivers, pagodas. Sources: the Huainanzi; the Shanhaijing; Journey to the West; New Year folklore. No local gods (Chinese folk deities are Tier B): shrines from every pantheon.

The Crossroads, the finale, level 54 (docs/BONUS_LEVELS_PLAN.md; GAME_DESIGN.md: The Crossroads, Act IV). Every region's land blended and fraying; the hazard rotates through all of them; all families; shrines from all pantheons; random 10:00 and 20:00 bosses; the Unweaver at 30:00. The Crossroads and the Unweaver are the game's own invented names (in the design).

Erebus, Pack 5 realm 1, the realm of the restless dead (docs/PACK_5_PLAN.md). Sources: Hesiod, Theogony 123, 211-217; Aristophanes, The Frogs 285-295; Pausanias 10.28.7; the Anglo-Saxon Chronicle for 1127; Orderic Vitalis 8.17. A realm: no local gods.

Karnstein, Pack 5 realm 2, the vampire domain (docs/PACK_5_PLAN.md). Sources: Le Fanu, Carmilla (1872); Polidori, The Vampyre (1819); Rymer and Prest, Varney the Vampire (1845-47); Calmet (1746). A realm: no local gods.

Ossory, Pack 5 realm 3, the werewolf forests (docs/PACK_5_PLAN.md). Sources: Gerald of Wales, Topographia Hibernica II.19 (c. 1188); Marie de France, Bisclavret; the Lai de Melion; the Beast of Gevaudan (1764-67). The saint of Gerald's tale is not used. A realm: no local gods.

The Brocken, Pack 5 realm 4, the witches' mountain (docs/PACK_5_PLAN.md). Sources: Goethe, Faust I (1808), Walpurgis Night; Praetorius, Blockes-Berges Verrichtung (1668); Silberschlag (1780); Leicestershire folklore of Black Annis. A realm: no local gods.
Nidavellir, Pack 6 realm 1, the dwarven forge-halls (docs/PACK_6_PLAN.md). Sources: Voluspa 37; Reginsmal; Skaldskaparmal 35 and 39. Loki is not a character. A realm: no local gods.

Svartalfheim, Pack 6 realm 2, the realm of the dark elves (docs/PACK_6_PLAN.md). Sources: Gylfaginning 17 and 34; Alvissmal; Skaldskaparmal 1; the Nibelungenlied, 3rd adventure. A realm: no local gods.
Mycendra, Pack 6 realm 3, the fungal city (docs/PACK_6_PLAN.md). The design's invented realm: no public-domain source; its monsters and bosses have plain descriptive names. A realm: no local gods.
The Myrmidon Hive, Pack 6 realm 4, the insect-warrior city (docs/PACK_6_PLAN.md). Sources: Ovid, Metamorphoses 7.614-660; Herodotus 3.102-105; Servius on Aeneid 4.402. A realm: no local gods.

Alfheim, Pack 7 realm 1, the realm of the elves (docs/PACK_7_PLAN.md). Sources: Grimnismal 5; Volundarkvida; Gylfaginning 17; the Old English charm Wid faerstice; Herder, Erlkonigs Tochter (1778); Goethe, Erlkonig (1782). Freyr is not a boss. A realm: no local gods.

Elfame, Pack 7 realm 2, the Fae Court (docs/PACK_7_PLAN.md). Sources: Thomas the Rhymer (Child 37); Tam Lin (Child 39); Lady Isabel and the Elf-Knight (Child 4); Thomas of Erceldoune. The teind to hell is left out. A realm: no local gods.
Arcadia, Pack 7 realm 3, the beastfolk wilds (docs/PACK_7_PLAN.md). Sources: Ovid, Metamorphoses 1.163-243; Apollodorus 2.5.3-6; Pausanias, Book 8. A realm: no local gods.
